svg.title: Magnite — Chat
svg.desc: Midnight desktop concept. Illustrative data. Editable vector shapes and SVG text.

g.text: A conversation with your own intelligence.

svg.text: RAG gives a language model relevant information from
1. Split your documents into searchable chunks.
2. Retrieve the chunks closest to your question.
3. Include those passages in the model’s context.
You get answers grounded in your own material.
